entities.summary: Thomson William "Thom" Gunn was an English poet who was praised for his early verses in England, where he was associated with The Movement, and his later poetry in America, where he adopted a looser, free-verse style. He wrote about his experience moving to San Francisco from England. He received numerous literary honours. His poems are reputed to possess a restrained elegance of philosophy. Thom Gunn was a poets & playwrights from Gravesend (1929-08-29, Gravesend–2004-04-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
